Final-Year Projects · 2026–27

A Working BLDC Motor Drive — Not a Paper Project

The BLDC motor is what moves every electric scooter, e-bike and EV fan in India. A final-year project built around it shows real, measurable engineering — speed, voltage, current and power, live on screen.

We build the complete working model on a sturdy panel, with every part labelled and wired neatly so it can be explained confidently at review and viva.

Suited to EEE, ECE, EIE, Mechatronics and Automobile students — individual or team projects.

// CASE STUDY — WIRELESS EV CHARGING STATION

Honest numbers, real engineering

A 12 V high-frequency transmitter charges a model EV's battery across an air gap. An ESP32 with two INA219 sensors shows input and output power on a 20×4 LCD, with a 16-LED ring for status. Students present the measured efficiency and explain where the losses go — which examiners value more than a perfect-looking demo.

Input  : 12.0 V × 0.90 A = 10.8 W
Output : 4.2 V × 0.15 A = 0.63 W
Transfer efficiency : 5.8 % (bench scale)
Display : team names + live readings
Safety : RCBO on AC input

About Edison Electrotech

Where Industry Experience Meets Precision Engineering

Edison Electrotech is a specialist electronics design and manufacturing firm based in Aruppukottai, Tamil Nadu. We build final-year student projects, lab trainer units for engineering colleges, and test instruments for automotive service networks.

Our founder brings a unique combination of hands-on automotive electrical diagnosis (Saud Bahwan Ford, Oman — 10 years), OEM technical training (Maruti Suzuki Regional Training Centre, Chennai), and instrument design experience (Lucas-TVS) that directly informs every product we build.

Every unit is designed, firmware-programmed and tested in-house — from circuit design to panel build, calibration and dispatch.
